name: PT Sinar Eka Selaras Tbk
summary: PT Sinar Eka Selaras Tbk distributes and retails lifestyle products and solutions of various brands in Indonesia. The company operates through Accessories, IoT and Others; Cellular Phones and Tablets; Computer & Other Electronic Devices; Fashion Apparel; and Automotive segments. Its accessory products include casings and covers, earphones, chargers, data cables, power banks, protective skins, consoles, game accessories, and other peripherals; and IoT products comprise smart home appliances, such as robots, vacuum cleaners, smart air purifiers, smart CCTVs, smart door locks, etc., as well as smart watches, handheld navigation systems, electric scooters, Bluetooth speakers, and drones.
